senses.sense_definition: An eating disorder characterized by an intense fear of gaining weight and self-imposed starvation, short for anorexia nervosa.

examples.text: She spent several months in the hospital recovering from severe <w>anorexia</w>.
Doctors warned the family that untreated <w>anorexia</w> can cause long-term damage to the heart.

senses.sense_definition: Loss of appetite or inability to eat, especially as a medical symptom of illness or medication.

examples.text: Common side effects of the new medication include nausea and temporary <w>anorexia</w>.
The patient experienced profound fatigue and <w>anorexia</w> during the course of the infection.

senses.sense_definition: A psychological state of being starved of or deeply deprived of something vital, such as emotion or intimacy.

examples.text: The therapist identified a pattern of emotional <w>anorexia</w> within their marriage.
Living in isolation for years led to a profound spiritual <w>anorexia</w> that was difficult to heal.
